body.x: Paru(www.paru.co.kr) will be introducing its photovoltaic trackers at Korea Energy Show 2016, which will run Nov. 8-11 at KINTEX.

It is a manufacturer of photovoltaic trackers that has the real-time sunlight sensing technology. In the show, it will also display the eco-friendly energy town in Suncheon Bay National Garden, Yeosu Expo, Chuncheon Carp Island. Other items that will be displayed are EPC, ESS, electric compact car, and other new businesses.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by Korea Energy Agency, Korea Energy Show 2016 is a comprehensive trade show covering new energy business, new and renewable energy, high-efficiency energy, energy environment, and energy policy technology. It was prepared to provide marketing support to the energy companies to contribute to the development and stimulation of the energy industry of Korea.
